fee_details:
- Annual Fee: Rs.1499 + taxes
- Renewal Fee: Rs.1499 + taxes
- Add-on fee: Nil
- Cash Advance Fee:
    - 2.5% of the amount withdrawn or Rs.500 (Domestic ATMs)
    - 3.5% of the amount withdrawn or Rs.500 (International ATMs)
- Finance Charges: 3.50% per month or 42% per annum
- Payment dishonor fee: 2% of the payment amount; minimum of Rs.450
- Statement request: Rs.100 per statement (more than 2 months old)
- Cheque payment fee: Rs.100
- Over limit fee: 2.5% of the over limit amount; minimum of Rs.600
- Rewards redemption fee: Rs.99
- Foreign currency transaction: 3.50%
- Late payment:
    - From Rs.0 to Rs.500: Nil
    - More than Rs.500 up to Rs.1,000: Rs.400
    - More than Rs.1,000 up to Rs.5,000: Rs.750
    - More than Rs.5,000 up to Rs.25,000: Rs.950
    - More than Rs.25,000 up to Rs.50,000: Rs.1,100
    - More than Rs.50,000: Rs.1,300
joining_perks: Get a Noise ColorFit Pulse Smart Watch worth Rs. 4,999 on joining
reward_structure:
- Get 2 reward points on every Rs.100 spent.
- Get 10 reward points on Rs.100 spent on pharmacy, dining and entertainment.

how_tos.Balance Transfer on EMI facility:
Step 1: Log into sbicard.com
Step 2: Select the 'Benefits' link on left hand navigation and choose 'Balance Transfer on EMI' option.
Step 3: Fill the required details and confirm to book Balance Transfer on EMI option.
how_tos.Flexipay facility:
Step 1: Log into sbicard.com
Step 2: Select the 'Flexipay' option from left hand navigation under the 'Benefits' section.
Step 3: Select the transaction (Rs.2,500) you want to convert into Flexipay, select the required details and confirm the booking.
how_tos.Easy Money facility:
Step 1: Log into sbicard.com
Step 2: Select the 'Easy Money' option from left hand navigation under the 'Benefits' section.
Step 3: Fill the required details and book Easy Money instantly.

miscellaneous: The SBI Card Pulse also gives its customers the option to avail easy money for short tenure at a comparatively low rate of interest. With the Easy Money option, the funds get delivered to the customer’s doorstep via a cheque or draft against the cash limit. The customer can also take an instant transfer to the bank account via NEFT.

faqs.Can an add-on card holder avail the Flex: No, the add-on card holder cannot avail the Flexipay facility.
faqs.Does the contactless transaction amount: Yes, the contactless payment mode allows payment up to Rs.5,000 only. For payments above Rs.5,000, the customer has to swipe the credit card.
faqs.On availing the Balance Transfer on EMI: Yes, you can repay the amount before the EMI tenure ends. However, a charge of 3% on the outstanding principal + GST will be applicable.
faqs.How much money can be availed using the: A minimum amount of Rs.5000 and maximum up to 75% of the available cash limit can be availed using the Easy Money facility.
faqs.Can an add-on card holder apply for Easy: No, the add-on card holder cannot apply for the Easy Money service.
